original_test_intent: Validate telemetry sourced from the specified INA3221 and NCP45495XMNTWG/OVRM devices, proving correct rail/channel identity, voltage/current/power scaling and plausible readings against the qualified platform power map under a documented operating point.
original_method: Select by row/variant; map each monitor chip instance through board/rail, controller/bus/address and channel/shunt parameters to its BMC SDR/API or vendor-tool property; document idle/load state and obtain complete raw counts plus converted units/status; compare voltage/current/power and aggregation relationships to approved tolerances or a calibrated reference; preserve all sensor/error logs without writes, threshold changes or raw probing of unknown registers.
manual_activity: A power/platform owner supplies the schematic/rail/channel/shunt map and controls the operating point or calibrated reference used for interpretation.
required_inputs: Unique identity resolution for the three-row code collision
Board revision and each INA3221/NCP45495XMNTWG instance, controller/bus/address, rail and channel map
Authoritative BMC SDR/Redfish/vendor-tool property IDs or read-safe register decoder
Shunt values/scaling/units, operating load, expected ranges/tolerances, aggregation and optional calibrated-reference procedure
safety_requirements: Select by row/variant and verify the intended BMC/platform before access
Use only approved read-only interfaces; do not probe unknown registers or issue raw writes
Protect credentials and preserve complete unfiltered output with timestamps
Do not infer chip/rail identity from INA/OVRM/PWR substrings or reuse PDB/PWR evidence
Stop on stale/missing/ambiguous channel, unit/scaling mismatch, out-of-range rail, communication error or hardware alarm
agent_execution_scope: Validate composite identity, sensor/property map, decoder/scaling and operating state
Collect complete read-only raw and converted channel evidence after access confirmation
Calculate approved rail/aggregation comparisons without verdict
Do not select unknown registers, change thresholds/power, clear logs, create load, reuse other variants or decide recovery
engineer_actions: Resolve duplicate-code ownership while preserving all three variants
Approve access interface, chip/rail/channel/shunt map, units/scaling, operating point and tolerances
Review telemetry/reference comparison and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: A complete `sdr list` may be useful only if each named monitor channel has an approved SDR mapping. Generic grep/head can omit channels and the PDB output label is wrong; some OVRM data may require a vendor interface.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the approved complete BMC/IPMI/Redfish/vendor read-only interface for exact channel/property IDs, preserving raw values, converted units, status and timestamps at the defined operating point.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The 10/10-minute estimates remain; no sensor list, channel count, load, range or pass criterion is inferred from TBD fields.

modernized_recommendation.status: MEDIUM PACKAGE-GATED INA3221_OVRM RAIL TELEMETRY AND SCALING VALIDATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind each telemetry value to its physical monitor instance, rail/channel and conversion formula, then compare complete raw/converted readings at a controlled operating point.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds collision-safe identity, schematic and access mapping, raw/scaled evidence, load context, tolerance/reference and secret-safe collection.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Generic PWR SDR matches or PDB data cannot prove that the specified INA3221 and NCP45495 channels, scaling or rails are correct.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Firmware aliases may hide chip identity, shunt/configuration values determine current scaling, and a single idle reading cannot validate a load-dependent range.

Per-channel raw counts, conversion formula, units/status and timestamped operating state

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The code also identifies unrelated PWR and PDB sensor rows, and DeepSeek's output instruction explicitly asks for row-2274 Sensor Check - PDB rather than INA3221/OVRM. The row variant is reliable, but code-only selection and historical output text are unsafe.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The named telemetry devices define the review purpose. Their access map, scaling, expected ranges and reference method can be supplied as project inputs.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2202 Wistron-HW-00483-V002: assign/approve a unique identity distinct from rows 2028 PWR and 2274 PDB; approve board revision plus each INA3221/NCP45495XMNTWG controller/bus/address/rail/channel/shunt map, authoritative IPMI/Redfish/vendor property or read-safe register decoder, raw-to-unit scaling, operating load, range/tolerance/aggregation criteria, optional calibrated reference, secret-safe access, error limits and recovery.

review_improvement: Eliminates PDB/PWR cross-variant contamination and turns vague telemetry into chip-, rail-, channel- and scaling-specific evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: The part numbers matter: INA3221 channels require board-specific shunt and rail mapping, while NCP45495 telemetry may not surface under a literal OVRM SDR name. A keyword grep cannot establish either identity or conversion. The correct review binds firmware properties to the schematic and records raw plus scaled values at a defined load. Because the code also names two different sensor tests, composite identity is mandatory and evidence cannot cross variants.
